name: Canvas HTML snippet tools (Hacks for Educators)

mentions.name: Canvas HTML snippet tools (Hacks for Educators)
mentions.description: This is a collection of free tools/scripts that generate HTML snippets for pasting into the Canvas LMS page editor, including striped tables, FAQs, flashcard-like study cards, an interactive story creator, and more. All tools are free and require no login.
mentions.source_excerpt: I enjoy writing little tools/scripts to help me create html code "snippets" that I can post into the html editor of my Canvas pages (e.g., striped tables, FAQs, flashcard-like study cards, an interactive story creator, and more).
